announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: This announcement confirms the outcome of the Annual General Meeting, which typically involves routine shareholder approvals such as director reappointments and auditor mandates. It signifies standard corporate governance compliance rather than any material strategic or financial change.
